title: ArtifactSchemaV1
description: JH-Agent OS Artifact contract. The model declares identity and content; the control layer validates task correlation and computes the authoritative version and SHA-256 (model-declared hashes are never trusted).

artifact_type.description: Phase 3 scope only: no external side effects. patch_text means generated patch text; applying patches is Phase 4.

content.description: Full artifact content. Stored in memory/SQLite for Phase 3; never written to the filesystem by the model path.
